Filmmaker Kashyap Questions India's Oscar Entry; Director Responds

Filmmaker Anurag Kashyap has questioned the selection process for India's official entry to the Oscars. The Marathi psychological thriller "Gondhal" was chosen as the entry. The director of "Gondhal," Santosh Davakhar, has responded to Kashyap's criticism, urging him to watch the film before passing judgment.
